description: The declared GET /config key surface (DEC-243, extended by DEC-285). Every key the daemon reports, with the mutability it reports it under. Pinned on the daemon side by daemon/tests/ipc_integration.rs::get_config_key_set_and_mutability_are_pinned, which fails if this list and the handler disagree; pinned on this side by tests/test_daemon_config_coverage.py, which fails if a mutable key has no Settings control. Adding a daemon config key means updating both, plus docs/08 § Config management.
